adapterKind.description: Echo of the negotiating profile's adapter kind.

contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

domainOutcomes.description: One entry per domain WITH a requirement, in the fixed domain order (screen, input, sensors, camera, offline-storage, notifications, deep-links).

blocking.description: Echo of the requirement's blocking flag (absent = false).

reason.description: Honest, deterministic reason when the outcome is `unsupported` or `unknown`; null when `satisfied`.

outcome.description: Overall worst-of outcome: blocked (a blocking requirement is definitively unmet) > unknown (a blocking requirement is undetermined) > degraded (a non-blocking shortfall) > permitted.

permittedInteractionModes.description: The honest interaction modes the profile supports for this task (INTERACTION_MODES declaration order). EMPTY when the overall outcome is `blocked` — the adapter must render the explicit blocked reasons instead.

profileRef.description: The profile snapshot this negotiation used.

requirementsRef.description: The requirements set this negotiation used.
